sloka: उपगम्य समाघ्राय विद्रवन्ति दिशो दश ।राक्षसः सो अपि तान् वन्यान् मृगान् मृगवधे रतः ॥३-४२-२९॥
transliteration: upagamya samāghrāya vidravanti diśo daśa ।rākṣasaḥ so api tān vanyān mṛgān mṛgavadhe rataḥ ॥3-42-29॥

translations.english: The demon who was interested in killing wild deer touched and felt them but did not kill or feed on them in order to hide his intention.
